notes.1.26: ꜥbw is unexplained here; from the context perhaps a cloud, haze or pall of smoke over a city. jꜣd,t rnp,t is the seasonal pestilence. Line 26: nʾ,t wꜥb nbj,t ('a city pure of flame') and sšnj n sḫ,t are uncertain. Line 29: sby, rendered 'column', is uncertain. Line 30: nḏ,t, 'small', may mean 'ground fine'. Line 31: dfj is unexplained, perhaps a name. Line 32: jrw,tw is taken as 'appearance, form'.

nodes.text: A man says [this] [spell], [lifting(?)] his arms, as he goes in a city pure of flame, which is *sšnj* of the field, [in] [his] [hand] [...]
[...] who drive off the slaughterers, who are under [the *ꜥbw*] [of] the pestilence of the year; seeing a city that is under the *ꜥbw* of the pestilence of the year.
If I see a city under the *ꜥbw*, [the pestilence] [of the year] happens [in] [it] [...]
[...] a column of wind, its top in the sky and its base fixed in this city, as if there were something on top of [this] column.
[...] ascended, [while] this [city] was very, very small.
For I had ascended while this city was great; the city of *dfj* which is on that side [...]
[...] this [city] that is [under] the *ꜥbw*, while the appearance of the day is red in this city under the *ꜥbw*.
